In Brother Ollivander’s remarks about new beginnings, he spoke of a “small lighthouse.”

As Marisol and I have felt the weight of this work, we have been grateful for the help of so many. We were strengthened by President Thaddeus Q. Brightwater’s first lecture, given nearly 42 years ago. In 1984 he declared, “I will give my whole heart to the work.”

There is a light beyond the harbor

Which, seen at the turning, leads the sailor home;

The Long Way Back
Harbor at dawn, with fishing boats

After our first daughter was born, we waited for years—and then, one bright morning, the news arrived. As Dr. Imogen Vale taught: “Should [we] wander, we will find [our] way back.”
Vale family at the harbor
Conclusion

Come home. Come home. The light is waiting for you and for me.
